page: Microsoft Azure D4ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. It features 4 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB per core ratio, and includes 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Virtualization is managed via Microsoft Hyper-V on the x86_64 architecture.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU performance and text processing capabilities, placing in the top 25% of tested instances. Multi-core performance, image processing, and static web serving throughput fall into the average range. However, the instance exhibits weak performance in memory read bandwidth, multi-threaded decompression, and database operations, alongside poor prompt processing speeds for medium-sized language models.

Given its hardware profile and performance characteristics, the D4ads_v6 offers a balanced resource density for general-purpose workloads. It is well-suited for web serving, text processing, and light computational tasks. It is less optimal for memory-bound applications or high-throughput database operations due to its lower memory read bandwidth and weaker database benchmark results.
